facts.fact: The Addis Ababa Civil Registration and Residency Service Agency says birth, death, marriage and divorce registration is replaced by a digital service across its 132 service centres.
facts.system: Addis Ababa digital civil registration service

facts.fact: The agency says its 132 service centres, centre to woreda, provide digital registration of births and deaths, as stated by Mayor Adanech Abebe.
